6237.text: Lord, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

6238.text: Sing praise to the Lord, you holy ones of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

6239.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

6240.text: As for me, I said in my prosperity, "I shall never be moved."

6241.text: You, Lord, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

6242.text: I cried to you, Lord. To the Lord I made supplication:

6243.text: "What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

6244.text: Hear, Lord, and have mercy on me. Lord, be my helper."

6245.text: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

6246.text: To the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. Lord my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

6247.text: In you, Lord, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

6248.text: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

6249.text: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name's sake lead me and guide me.

6250.text: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

6251.text: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, Lord, God of truth.

6252.text: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the Lord.

6253.text: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

6254.text: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

6255.text: Have mercy on me, Lord, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

6256.text: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

6257.text: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A fear to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

6258.text: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

6259.text: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

6260.text: But I trust in you, Lord. I said, "You are my God."

6261.text: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

6262.text: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

6263.text: Let me not be disappointed, Lord, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

6264.text: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

6265.text: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

6266.text: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

6267.text: Praise be to the Lord, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

6268.text: As for me, I said in my haste, "I am cut off from before your eyes." Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

6269.text: Oh love the Lord, all you his holy ones! The Lord preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

6270.text: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the Lord.

6271.text: Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

6272.text: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord doesn't impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

6273.text: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

6274.text: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

6275.text: I acknowledged my sin to you. I did not hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the Lord, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

6276.text: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

6277.text: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

6278.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

6279.text: Do not be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

6280.text: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the Lord.

6281.text: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

6282.text: Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

6283.text: Give thanks to the Lord with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

6284.text: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

6285.text: For the word of the Lord is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

6286.text: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the Lord.

6287.text: By the Lord's word, the heavens were made; all their army by the breath of his mouth.

6288.text: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

6289.text: Let all the earth fear the Lord. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

6290.text: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

6291.text: The Lord brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

6292.text: The counsel of the Lord stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

6293.text: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

6294.text: The Lord looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

6295.text: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

6296.text: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

6297.text: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

6298.text: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

6299.text: Behold, the Lord's eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness;

6300.text: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

6301.text: Our soul has waited for the Lord. He is our help and our shield.

6302.text: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

6303.text: Let your loving kindness be on us, Lord, since we have hoped in you.

6304.text: ALEPH I will bless the Lord at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

6305.text: My soul shall boast in the Lord. The humble shall hear of it, and be glad.

6306.text: Oh magnify the Lord with me. Let us exalt his name together.

6307.text: I sought the Lord, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

6308.text: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

6309.text: This poor man cried, and the Lord heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

6310.text: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

6311.text: Oh taste and see that the Lord is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

6312.text: Oh fear the Lord, you his holy ones, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

6313.text: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the Lord shall not lack any good thing.

6314.text: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

6315.text: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

6316.text: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

6317.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

6318.text: The Lord's eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

6319.text: The Lord's face is against those who do evil, to cut off the memory of them from the earth.

6320.text: They cried, and the Lord hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

6321.text: The Lord is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

6322.text: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the Lord delivers him out of them all.

6323.text: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

6324.text: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

6325.text: The Lord redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

6326.text: Contend, Lord, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

6327.text: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

6328.text: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, "I am your salvation."

6329.text: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

6330.text: Let them be as chaff before the wind, The Lord's angel driving them on.

6331.text: Let their way be dark and slippery, The Lord's angel pursuing them.

6332.text: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

6333.text: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

6334.text: My soul shall be joyful in the Lord. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

6335.text: All my bones shall say, "Lord, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?"

6336.text: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I do not know about.

6337.text: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

6338.text: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into my own bosom.

6339.text: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

6340.text: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I did not know it. They tore at me, and did not cease.

6341.text: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

6342.text: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

6343.text: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

6344.text: Do not let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause and wink their eyes.

6345.text: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

6346.text: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, "Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!"

6347.text: You have seen it, Lord. Do not keep silent. Lord, do not be far from me.

6348.text: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

6349.text: Vindicate me, Lord my God, according to your righteousness. Do not let them gloat over me.

6350.text: Do not let them say in their heart, "Aha! That's the way we want it!" Do not let them say, "We have swallowed him up!"

6351.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

6352.text: Let them shout for joy and be glad, who favor my righteous cause. Yes, let them say continually, "The Lord be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!"

6353.text: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

6354.text: An oracle is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: "There is no fear of God before his eyes."

6355.text: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

6356.text: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

6357.text: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn't abhor evil.

6358.text: Your loving kindness, Lord, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

6359.text: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. Lord, you preserve man and animal.

6360.text: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

6361.text: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

6362.text: For with you is the spring of life. In your light shall we see light.

6363.text: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

6364.text: Do not let the foot of pride come against me. Do not let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

6365.text: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

6366.text: ALEPH Do not fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

6367.text: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

6368.text: Trust in the Lord, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

6369.text: Also delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

6370.text: Commit your way to the Lord. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

6371.text: he will make your righteousness go forth as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

6372.text: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him. Do not fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

6373.text: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Do not fret, it leads only to evildoing.

6374.text: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the Lord shall inherit the land.

6375.text: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn't there.

6376.text: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

6377.text: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

6378.text: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

6379.text: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright in the way.

6380.text: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

6381.text: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

6382.text: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the Lord upholds the righteous.

6383.text: The Lord knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

6384.text: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

6385.text: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the Lord shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish- vanish like smoke.

6386.text: The wicked borrow, and do not pay back, but the righteous give generously.

6387.text: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

6388.text: A man's goings are established by the Lord. He delights in his way.

6389.text: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the Lord holds him up with his hand.

6390.text: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

6391.text: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His seed is blessed.

6392.text: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

6393.text: For the Lord loves justice, and doesn't forsake his holy ones. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

6394.text: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

6395.text: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

6396.text: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

6397.text: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.

6398.text: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

6399.text: Wait for the Lord, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

6400.text: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

6401.text: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

6402.text: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

6403.text: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

6404.text: But the salvation of the righteous is from the Lord. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

6405.text: The Lord helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.

6406.text: Lord, do not rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

6407.text: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

6408.text: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

6409.text: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

6410.text: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt, because of my foolishness.

6411.text: I am pained and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

6412.text: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

6413.text: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

6414.text: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

6415.text: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

6416.text: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

6417.text: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

6418.text: But I, as a deaf man, do not hear. I am as a mute man who doesn't open his mouth.

6419.text: Yes, I am as a man who doesn't hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

6420.text: For in you, Lord, do I hope. You will answer, Lord my God.

6421.text: For I said, "Do not let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips."

6422.text: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

6423.text: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

6424.text: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

6425.text: They who also render evil for good are adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

6426.text: Do not forsake me, Lord. My God, do not be far from me.

6427.text: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

6428.text: I said, "I will watch my ways, so that I do not sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me."

6429.text: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

6430.text: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned: I spoke with my tongue:

6431.text: "Lord, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

6432.text: Behold, you have made my days handbreadths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath." Selah.

6433.text: "Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn't know who shall gather.

6434.text: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

6435.text: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Do not make me the reproach of the foolish.

6436.text: I was mute. I did not open my mouth, because you did it.

6437.text: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

6438.text: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, You consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath." Selah.

6439.text: "Hear my prayer, Lord, and give ear to my cry. Do not be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

6440.text: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away, and exist no more."

6441.text: I waited patiently for the Lord. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

6442.text: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

6443.text: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

6444.text: Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his trust, and doesn't respect the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

6445.text: Many, Lord, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can't be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

6446.text: Sacrifice and offering you did not desire, but a body you have prepared for me. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

6447.text: Then I said, "Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

6448.text: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your Law is within my heart."

6449.text: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, Lord, you know.

6450.text: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

6451.text: Do not withhold your tender mercies from me, Lord. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

6452.text: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

6453.text: Be pleased, Lord, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, Lord.

6454.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

6455.text: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, "Aha! Aha!"

6456.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, "Let the Lord be exalted!"

6457.text: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Do not delay, my God.

6458.text: Blessed is he who considers the poor. The Lord will deliver him in the day of evil.

6459.text: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

6460.text: The Lord will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

6461.text: I said, "Lord, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you."

6462.text: My enemies speak evil against me: "When will he die, and his name perish?"

6463.text: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

6464.text: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

6465.text: "An evil disease," they say, "has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more."

6466.text: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

6467.text: But you, Lord, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

6468.text: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn't triumph over me.

6469.text: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

6470.text: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

6471.text: As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

6472.text: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

6473.text: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?"

6474.text: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

6475.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

6476.text: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

6477.text: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

6478.text: The Lord will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

6479.text: I will ask God, my rock, "Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

6480.text: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, "Where is your God?"

6481.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

6482.text: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

6483.text: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

6484.text: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, To your tents.

6485.text: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

6486.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

6487.text: We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us, what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

6488.text: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

6489.text: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, and your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

6490.text: You are my King, God. Command victories for Jacob!

6491.text: Through you, will we push down our adversaries. Through your name, will we tread them under who rise up against us.

6492.text: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

6493.text: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

6494.text: In God we have made our boast all day long, we will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

6495.text: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and do not go out with our armies.

6496.text: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take spoil for themselves.

6497.text: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

6498.text: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

6499.text: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

6500.text: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

6501.text: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

6502.text: At the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

6503.text: All this has come on us, yet have we not forgotten you, Neither have we been false to your covenant.

6504.text: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

6505.text: Though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

6506.text: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread forth our hands to a strange god;

6507.text: won't God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

6508.text: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

6509.text: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Do not reject us forever.

6510.text: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

6511.text: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body cleaves to the earth.

6512.text: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness' sake.

6513.text: My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

6514.text: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

6515.text: Gird your sword on your thigh, mighty one: your splendor and your majesty.

6516.text: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

6517.text: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king's enemies.

6518.text: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

6519.text: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

6520.text: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

6521.text: Kings' daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

6522.text: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father's house.

6523.text: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

6524.text: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

6525.text: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

6526.text: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

6527.text: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king's palace.

6528.text: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

6529.text: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

6530.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

6531.text: Therefore we won't be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

6532.text: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

6533.text: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

6534.text: God is in her midst. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

6535.text: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice, and the earth melted.

6536.text: The Lord of hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

6537.text: Come, see the Lord's works, what desolations he has made in the earth.

6538.text: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

6539.text: "Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth."

6540.text: The Lord of hosts is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

6541.text: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

6542.text: For the Lord Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

6543.text: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

6544.text: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

6545.text: God has gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

6546.text: Sing praise to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.

6547.text: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

6548.text: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

6549.text: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

6550.text: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

6551.text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

6552.text: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

6553.text: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

6554.text: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

6555.text: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

6556.text: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

6557.text: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the Lord of hosts, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

6558.text: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the midst of your temple.

6559.text: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

6560.text: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice, Because of your judgments.

6561.text: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

6562.text: Consider her defenses. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

6563.text: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

6564.text: Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

6565.text: both low and high, rich and poor together.

6566.text: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart shall utter understanding.

6567.text: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will open my riddle on the harp.

6568.text: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

6569.text: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches-

6570.text: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

6571.text: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

6572.text: That he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

6573.text: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

6574.text: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

6575.text: But man, despite his riches, doesn't endure. He is like the animals that perish.

6576.text: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

6577.text: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

6578.text: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

6579.text: Do not be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased.

6580.text: For when he dies he shall carry nothing away. His glory shall not descend after him.

6581.text: Though while he lived he blessed his soul- and men praise you when you do well for yourself-

6582.text: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

6583.text: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

6584.text: The Mighty One, God, the Lord, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

6585.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines forth.

6586.text: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

6587.text: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

6588.text: "Gather my holy ones together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice."

6589.text: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

6590.text: "Hear, my people, and I will speak; Israel, and I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

6591.text: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

6592.text: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

6593.text: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

6594.text: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

6595.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

6596.text: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

6597.text: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

6598.text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me."

6599.text: But to the wicked God says, "What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

6600.text: seeing you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

6601.text: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

6602.text: "You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

6603.text: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother's son.

6604.text: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

6605.text: "Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be none to deliver.

6606.text: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God's salvation to him."

6607.text: Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

6608.text: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

6609.text: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

6610.text: Against you, and you only, have I sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight; that you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

6611.text: Behold, I was brought forth in iniquity. In sin my mother conceived me.

6612.text: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

6613.text: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

6614.text: Let me hear joy and gladness, That the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

6615.text: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

6616.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

6617.text: Do not throw me from your presence, and do not take your holy Spirit from me.

6618.text: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

6619.text: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners shall be converted to you.

6620.text: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue shall sing aloud of your righteousness.

6621.text: Lord, open my lips. My mouth shall declare your praise.

6622.text: For you do not delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

6623.text: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. A broken and contrite heart, O God, you will not despise.

6624.text: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

6625.text: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

6626.text: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God's loving kindness endures continually.

6627.text: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

6628.text: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

6629.text: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

6630.text: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

6631.text: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

6632.text: "Behold, this is the man who did not make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness."

6633.text: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God's house. I trust in God's loving kindness forever and ever.

6634.text: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your holy ones.

6635.text: The fool has said in his heart, "There is no God." They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

6636.text: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

6637.text: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

6638.text: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and do not call on God?

6639.text: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

6640.text: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

6641.text: Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

6642.text: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

6643.text: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven't set God before them. Selah.

6644.text: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

6645.text: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

6646.text: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, Lord, for it is good.

6647.text: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

6648.text: Listen to my prayer, God. Do not hide yourself from my supplication.

6649.text: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

6650.text: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

6651.text: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

6652.text: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

6653.text: I said, "Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

6654.text: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness." Selah.

6655.text: "I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm."

6656.text: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

6657.text: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

6658.text: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies do not depart from her streets.

6659.text: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hid myself from him.

6660.text: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

6661.text: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God's house with company.

6662.text: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

6663.text: As for me, I will call on God. The Lord will save me.

6664.text: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

6665.text: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

6666.text: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who do not fear God.

6667.text: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

6668.text: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

6669.text: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

6670.text: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

6671.text: Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

6672.text: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

6673.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

6674.text: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

6675.text: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

6676.text: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps, they are eager to take my life.

6677.text: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

6678.text: You number my wanderings. You put my tears into your bottle. Aren't they in your book?

6679.text: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this, that God is for me.

6680.text: In God, I will praise his word. In the Lord, I will praise his word.

6681.text: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

6682.text: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

6683.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

6684.text: Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

6685.text: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

6686.text: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

6687.text: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

6688.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

6689.text: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into its midst themselves. Selah.

6690.text: My heart is steadfast, God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

6691.text: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, psaltery and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

6692.text: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

6693.text: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

6694.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

6695.text: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

6696.text: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.

6697.text: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

6698.text: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

6699.text: which doesn't listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

6700.text: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Lord.

6701.text: Let them vanish as water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

6702.text: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

6703.text: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

6704.text: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;

6705.text: so that men shall say, "Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth."

6706.text: Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

6707.text: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

6708.text: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, Lord.

6709.text: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

6710.text: You, Lord God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

6711.text: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

6712.text: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, "For," they say, "who hears us?"

6713.text: But you, Lord, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

6714.text: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

6715.text: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

6716.text: Do not kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

6717.text: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

6718.text: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

6719.text: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

6720.text: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren't satisfied.

6721.text: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

6722.text: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

6723.text: God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

6724.text: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

6725.text: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

6726.text: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

6727.text: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

6728.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

6729.text: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

6730.text: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my shoe on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia."

6731.text: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

6732.text: Haven't you, God, rejected us? You do not go out with our armies, God.

6733.text: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

6734.text: Through God we shall do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

6735.text: Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

6736.text: From the end of the earth, I will call to you, when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

6737.text: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

6738.text: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

6739.text: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

6740.text: You will prolong the king's life; his years shall be for generations.

6741.text: He shall be enthroned in God's presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

6742.text: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

6743.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

6744.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress- I will never be greatly shaken.

6745.text: How long will you assault a man, would all of you throw him down, Like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

6746.text: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

6747.text: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

6748.text: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

6749.text: With God is my salvation and my honor. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

6750.text: Trust in him at all times, O people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

6751.text: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

6752.text: Do not trust in oppression. Do not become vain in robbery. If riches increase, do not set your heart on them.

6753.text: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

6754.text: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

6755.text: God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

6756.text: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

6757.text: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

6758.text: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

6759.text: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

6760.text: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

6761.text: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

6762.text: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

6763.text: But those who seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

6764.text: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

6765.text: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

6766.text: Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

6767.text: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

6768.text: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

6769.text: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

6770.text: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, "Who will see them?"

6771.text: They plot injustice, saying, "We have made a perfect plan!" Surely man's mind and heart are cunning.

6772.text: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

6773.text: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

6774.text: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

6775.text: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

6776.text: Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. To you shall vows be performed.

6777.text: You who hear prayer, to you all men will come.

6778.text: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

6779.text: Blessed is one whom you choose, and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

6780.text: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea;

6781.text: Who by his power forms the mountains, having armed yourself with strength;

6782.text: who stills the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

6783.text: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning's dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

6784.text: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

6785.text: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

6786.text: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

6787.text: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

6788.text: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

6789.text: Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

6790.text: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

6791.text: Tell God, "How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

6792.text: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name." Selah.

6793.text: Come, and see God's deeds- awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

6794.text: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

6795.text: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

6796.text: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

6797.text: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn't allow our feet to be moved.

6798.text: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

6799.text: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

6800.text: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

6801.text: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

6802.text: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

6803.text: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

6804.text: Come, and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

6805.text: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

6806.text: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn't have listened.

6807.text: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

6808.text: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

6809.text: May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

6810.text: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

6811.text: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

6812.text: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

6813.text: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

6814.text: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

6815.text: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

6816.text: Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

6817.text: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

6818.text: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

6819.text: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to Yah, his name! Rejoice before him!

6820.text: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

6821.text: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

6822.text: God, when you went forth before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

6823.text: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai- at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

6824.text: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance, when it was weary.

6825.text: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

6826.text: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

6827.text: "Kings of armies flee! They flee!" She who waits at home divides the spoil,

6828.text: while you sleep among the campfires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

6829.text: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

6830.text: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

6831.text: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the Lord will dwell there forever.

6832.text: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

6833.text: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among men, yes, among the rebellious also, that Yah, God, might dwell there.

6834.text: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

6835.text: God is to us a God of deliverance. To the Lord, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

6836.text: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

6837.text: The Lord said, "I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea;

6838.text: That you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies."

6839.text: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

6840.text: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, in the midst of the ladies playing with tambourines,

6841.text: "Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!"

6842.text: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

6843.text: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

6844.text: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings shall bring presents to you.

6845.text: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the peoples. Being humbled, may it bring bars of silver. Scatter the nations that delight in war.

6846.text: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

6847.text: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord! Selah.

6848.text: To him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

6849.text: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

6850.text: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

6851.text: Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

6852.text: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

6853.text: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail, looking for my God.

6854.text: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I did not take away.

6855.text: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren't hidden from you.

6856.text: Do not let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord God of Hosts. Do not let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

6857.text: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

6858.text: I have become a stranger to my brothers, a foreigner to my mother's children.

6859.text: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

6860.text: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

6861.text: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

6862.text: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

6863.text: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Lord, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

6864.text: Deliver me out of the mire, and do not let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

6865.text: Do not let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Do not let the pit shut its mouth on me.

6866.text: Answer me, Lord, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

6867.text: Do not hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

6868.text: Draw near to my soul, and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

6869.text: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

6870.text: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

6871.text: They also gave me gall for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

6872.text: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

6873.text: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can't see. Let their backs be continually bent.

6874.text: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

6875.text: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

6876.text: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

6877.text: Charge them with crime upon crime. Do not let them come into your righteousness.

6878.text: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

6879.text: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

6880.text: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

6881.text: It will please the Lord better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

6882.text: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

6883.text: For the Lord hears the needy, and doesn't despise his captive people.

6884.text: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

6885.text: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

6886.text: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

6887.text: Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, Lord.

6888.text: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

6889.text: Let them be turned because of their shame Who say, "Aha! Aha!"

6890.text: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, "Let God be exalted!"

6891.text: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. Lord, do not delay.

6892.text: In you, Lord, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

6893.text: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

6894.text: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

6895.text: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

6896.text: For you are my hope, Lord God; my confidence from my youth.

6897.text: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother's womb. I will always praise you.

6898.text: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

6899.text: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all the day.

6900.text: Do not reject me in my old age. Do not forsake me when my strength fails.

6901.text: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

6902.text: saying, "God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him."

6903.text: God, do not be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

6904.text: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

6905.text: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

6906.text: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I do not know its full measure.

6907.text: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord God. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

6908.text: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

6909.text: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, do not forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

6910.text: Your righteousness also, God, reaches to the heavens; you have done great things. God, who is like you?

6911.text: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

6912.text: Increase my honor, and comfort me again.

6913.text: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

6914.text: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

6915.text: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

6916.text: God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

6917.text: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

6918.text: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

6919.text: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

6920.text: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

6921.text: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

6922.text: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

6923.text: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

6924.text: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

6925.text: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

6926.text: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

6927.text: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

6928.text: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

6929.text: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

6930.text: They shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba. Men shall pray for him continually. They shall bless him all day long.

6931.text: There shall be abundance of grain throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

6932.text: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

6933.text: Praise be to the Lord God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

6934.text: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

6935.text: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

6936.text: Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

6937.text: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

6938.text: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

6939.text: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

6940.text: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

6941.text: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

6942.text: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

6943.text: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

6944.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

6945.text: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

6946.text: They say, "How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?"

6947.text: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

6948.text: Surely in vain I have cleansed my heart, and washed my hands in innocence,

6949.text: For all day long have I been plagued, and punished every morning.

6950.text: If I had said, "I will speak thus;" behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

6951.text: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me;

6952.text: Until I entered God's sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

6953.text: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

6954.text: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

6955.text: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

6956.text: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

6957.text: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

6958.text: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

6959.text: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

6960.text: Who do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth who I desire besides you.

6961.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

6962.text: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

6963.text: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord God my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

6964.text: God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

6965.text: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance; Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

6966.text: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

6967.text: Your adversaries have roared in the midst of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

6968.text: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

6969.text: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

6970.text: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

6971.text: They said in their heart, "We will crush them completely." They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

6972.text: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

6973.text: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

6974.text: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it out of your pocket and consume them!

6975.text: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

6976.text: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

6977.text: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

6978.text: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

6979.text: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

6980.text: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

6981.text: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, Lord. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

6982.text: Do not deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Do not forget the life of your poor forever.

6983.text: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

6984.text: Do not let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

6985.text: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

6986.text: Do not forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

6987.text: We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

6988.text: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

6989.text: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

6990.text: I said to the arrogant, "Do not boast!" I said to the wicked, "Do not lift up the horn.

6991.text: Do not lift up your horn on high. Do not speak with a stiff neck."

6992.text: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

6993.text: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

6994.text: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

6995.text: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

6996.text: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

6997.text: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

6998.text: His tabernacle is also in Salem; His dwelling place in Zion.

6999.text: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

7000.text: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

7001.text: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.
