7002.text: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a deep sleep.

7003.text: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

7004.text: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

7005.text: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

7006.text: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

7007.text: Make vows to the Lord your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

7008.text: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

7009.text: My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

7010.text: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and did not get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

7011.text: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

7012.text: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can't speak.

7013.text: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

7014.text: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

7015.text: "Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

7016.text: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

7017.text: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?" Selah.

7018.text: Then I thought, "I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High."

7019.text: I will remember Yah's deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

7020.text: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

7021.text: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

7022.text: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

7023.text: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

7024.text: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

7025.text: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

7026.text: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

7027.text: Your way was through the sea; your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

7028.text: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

7029.text: Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

7030.text: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

7031.text: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

7032.text: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the Lord, his strength, and his wondrous works that he has done.

7033.text: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

7034.text: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

7035.text: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments,

7036.text: and might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that did not make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

7037.text: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

7038.text: They did not keep God's covenant, and refused to walk by his Law.

7039.text: They forgot his doings, his wondrous works that he had shown them.

7040.text: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

7041.text: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

7042.text: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

7043.text: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

7044.text: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

7045.text: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

7046.text: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

7047.text: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, "Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

7048.text: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide flesh for his people?"

7049.text: Therefore the Lord heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

7050.text: because they did not believe in God, and did not trust in his salvation.

7051.text: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

7052.text: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them bread from heaven.

7053.text: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

7054.text: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

7055.text: He rained also flesh on them as the dust; winged birds as the sand of the seas.

7056.text: He let them fall in the midst of their camp, around their habitations.

7057.text: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

7058.text: They did not turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

7059.text: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of the fattest of them, and struck down the young men of Israel.

7060.text: For all this they still sinned, and did not believe in his wondrous works.

7061.text: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

7062.text: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

7063.text: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

7064.text: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

7065.text: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

7066.text: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and did not destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and did not stir up all his wrath.

7067.text: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn't come again.

7068.text: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

7069.text: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

7070.text: They did not remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

7071.text: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

7072.text: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

7073.text: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

7074.text: He gave also their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

7075.text: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

7076.text: He gave over their livestock also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

7077.text: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of destroying angels.

7078.text: He made a path for his anger. He did not spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

7079.text: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

7080.text: But he led forth his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

7081.text: He led them safely, so that they weren't afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

7082.text: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

7083.text: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

7084.text: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and did not keep his testimonies;

7085.text: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were turned aside like a deceitful bow.

7086.text: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

7087.text: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel;

7088.text: So that he forsook the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men;

7089.text: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary's hand.

7090.text: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

7091.text: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

7092.text: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn't weep.

7093.text: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

7094.text: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

7095.text: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and did not choose the tribe of Ephraim,

7096.text: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

7097.text: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

7098.text: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

7099.text: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

7100.text: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

7101.text: God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

7102.text: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your holy ones to the animals of the earth.

7103.text: Their blood they have shed like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

7104.text: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

7105.text: How long, Lord? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

7106.text: Pour out your wrath on the nations that do not know you; on the kingdoms that do not call on your name;

7107.text: For they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

7108.text: Do not hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

7109.text: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.

7110.text: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God?" Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants' blood is being poured out.

7111.text: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

7112.text: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

7113.text: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

7114.text: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine forth.

7115.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

7116.text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

7117.text: Lord God of Hosts, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

7118.text: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

7119.text: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

7120.text: Turn us again, God of Hosts. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

7121.text: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

7122.text: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

7123.text: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God's cedars.

7124.text: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.

7125.text: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

7126.text: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

7127.text: Turn again, we beg you, God of Hosts. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

7128.text: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

7129.text: It's burned with fire. It's cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

7130.text: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

7131.text: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

7132.text: Turn us again, Lord God of Hosts. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

7133.text: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

7134.text: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

7135.text: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

7136.text: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

7137.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I did not know.

7138.text: "I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

7139.text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah." Selah.

7140.text: "Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

7141.text: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

7142.text: I am the Lord, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

7143.text: But my people did not listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

7144.text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

7145.text: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

7146.text: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

7147.text: The haters of the Lord would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

7148.text: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock."

7149.text: God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

7150.text: "How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?" Selah.

7151.text: "Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

7152.text: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked."

7153.text: They do not know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

7154.text: I said, "You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

7155.text: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers."

7156.text: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

7157.text: God, do not keep silent. Do not keep silent, and do not be still, God.

7158.text: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

7159.text: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

7160.text: "Come," they say, "and let's destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more."

7161.text: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

7162.text: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

7163.text: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

7164.text: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

7165.text: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

7166.text: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

7167.text: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb; yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna;

7168.text: who said, "Let us take possession of God's pasturelands."

7169.text: My God, make them like tumbleweed; like chaff before the wind.

7170.text: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

7171.text: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

7172.text: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, Lord.

7173.text: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

7174.text: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the Lord, are the Most High over all the earth.

7175.text: How lovely are your dwellings, Lord of hosts!

7176.text: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the Lord. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

7177.text: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

7178.text: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

7179.text: Blessed are those whose strength is in you; who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

7180.text: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

7181.text: They go from strength to strength. Everyone of them appears before God in Zion.

7182.text: Lord, God of Hosts, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

7183.text: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

7184.text: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

7185.text: For the Lord God is a sun and a shield. The Lord will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

7186.text: Lord of hosts, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

7187.text: Lord, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

7188.text: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

7189.text: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

7190.text: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

7191.text: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

7192.text: Won't you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

7193.text: Show us your loving kindness, Lord. Grant us your salvation.

7194.text: I will hear what God, the Lord, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his holy ones; but let them not turn again to folly.

7195.text: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

7196.text: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

7197.text: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

7198.text: Yes, the Lord will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

7199.text: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.

7200.text: Hear, Lord, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

7201.text: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

7202.text: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

7203.text: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

7204.text: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive; abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

7205.text: Hear, Lord, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

7206.text: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

7207.text: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

7208.text: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

7209.text: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

7210.text: Teach me your way, Lord. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

7211.text: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forevermore.

7212.text: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

7213.text: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they do not hold regard for you before them.

7214.text: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

7215.text: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your handmaid.

7216.text: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, Lord, have helped me, and comforted me.

7217.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

7218.text: The Lord loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

7219.text: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

7220.text: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: "This one was born there."

7221.text: Yes, of Zion it will be said, "This one and that one was born in her;" the Most High himself will establish her.

7222.text: The Lord will count, when he writes up the peoples, "This one was born there." Selah.

7223.text: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, "All my springs are in you."

7224.text: Lord, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

7225.text: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

7226.text: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

7227.text: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

7228.text: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

7229.text: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

7230.text: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

7231.text: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can't escape.

7232.text: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, Lord. I have spread out my hands to you.

7233.text: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the dead rise up and praise you? Selah.

7234.text: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

7235.text: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

7236.text: But to you, Lord, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

7237.text: Lord, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

7238.text: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

7239.text: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

7240.text: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

7241.text: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

7242.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of the Lord forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

7243.text: I indeed declare, "Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them."

7244.text: "I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

7245.text: 'I will establish your seed forever, and build up your throne to all generations.'" Selah.

7246.text: The heavens will praise your wonders, Lord; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

7247.text: For who in the skies can be compared to the Lord? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the Lord,

7248.text: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

7249.text: Lord, God of Hosts, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.

7250.text: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

7251.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

7252.text: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

7253.text: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

7254.text: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

7255.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

7256.text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

7257.text: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

7258.text: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

7259.text: For our shield belongs to the Lord; our king to the Holy One of Israel.

7260.text: Then you spoke in vision to your holy ones, and said, "I have bestowed strength on the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

7261.text: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

7262.text: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

7263.text: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

7264.text: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

7265.text: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

7266.text: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

7267.text: He will call to me, 'You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!'

7268.text: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

7269.text: I will keep my loving kindness for him forevermore. My covenant will stand firm with him.

7270.text: I will also make his seed endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

7271.text: If his children forsake my Law, and do not walk in my ordinances;

7272.text: if they break my statutes, and do not keep my commandments;

7273.text: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

7274.text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

7275.text: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

7276.text: Once have I sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

7277.text: His seed will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

7278.text: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky." Selah.

7279.text: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

7280.text: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

7281.text: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

7282.text: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

7283.text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

7284.text: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven't supported him in battle.

7285.text: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

7286.text: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

7287.text: How long, Lord? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

7288.text: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!

7289.text: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

7290.text: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

7291.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

7292.text: With which your enemies have mocked, Lord, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

7293.text: Blessed be the Lord forevermore. Amen, and Amen.

7294.text: Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

7295.text: Before the mountains were brought forth, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

7296.text: You turn man to destruction, saying, "Return, you children of men."

7297.text: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

7298.text: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

7299.text: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

7300.text: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

7301.text: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

7302.text: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

7303.text: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

7304.text: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

7305.text: So teach us to number our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

7306.text: Relent, Lord! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

7307.text: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

7308.text: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

7309.text: Let your work appear to your servants; your glory to their children.

7310.text: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us; establish the work of our hands for us; yes, establish the work of our hands.

7311.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

7312.text: I will say of the Lord, "He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust."

7313.text: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

7314.text: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

7315.text: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day;

7316.text: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

7317.text: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

7318.text: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

7319.text: Because you have made Lord your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

7320.text: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

7321.text: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

7322.text: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won't dash your foot against a stone.

7323.text: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

7324.text: "Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

7325.text: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

7326.text: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation."

7327.text: It is a good thing to give thanks to the Lord, to sing praises to your name, Most High;

7328.text: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

7329.text: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

7330.text: For you, Lord, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

7331.text: How great are your works, Lord! Your thoughts are very deep.

7332.text: A senseless man doesn't know, neither does a fool understand this:

7333.text: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

7334.text: But you, Lord, are on high forevermore.

7335.text: For, behold, your enemies, Lord, for, behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

7336.text: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

7337.text: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

7338.text: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

7339.text: They are planted in the Lord's house. They will flourish in our God's courts.

7340.text: They will still bring forth fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

7341.text: to show that the Lord is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

7342.text: The Lord reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The Lord is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can't be moved.

7343.text: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

7344.text: The floods have lifted up, Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

7345.text: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, The Lord on high is mighty.

7346.text: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, Lord, forevermore.

7347.text: Lord, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine forth.

7348.text: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

7349.text: Lord, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

7350.text: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

7351.text: They break your people in pieces, Lord, and afflict your heritage.

7352.text: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

7353.text: They say, "Yah will not see, neither will Jacob's God consider."

7354.text: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

7355.text: He who implanted the ear, won't he hear? He who formed the eye, won't he see?

7356.text: He who disciplines the nations, won't he punish? He who teaches man knows.

7357.text: The Lord knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

7358.text: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, Yah, and teach out of your Law;

7359.text: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

7360.text: For the Lord won't reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

7361.text: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

7362.text: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

7363.text: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

7364.text: When I said, "My foot is slipping!" Your loving kindness, Lord, held me up.

7365.text: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

7366.text: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

7367.text: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

7368.text: But the Lord has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

7369.text: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The Lord, our God, will cut them off.

7370.text: Oh come, let's sing to the Lord. Let's shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

7371.text: Let's come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let's extol him with songs!

7372.text: For the Lord is a great God, a great King above all gods.

7373.text: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

7374.text: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

7375.text: Oh come, let's worship and bow down. Let's kneel before the Lord, our Maker,

7376.text: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

7377.text: Do not harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

7378.text: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

7379.text: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, "It is a people that errs in their heart. They have not known my ways."

7380.text: Therefore I swore in my wrath, "They won't enter into my rest."

7381.text: Sing to the Lord a new song! Sing to the Lord, all the earth.

7382.text: Sing to the Lord! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

7383.text: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

7384.text: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

7385.text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the Lord made the heavens.

7386.text: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

7387.text: Ascribe to the Lord, you families of nations, ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

7388.text: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

7389.text: Worship the Lord in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

7390.text: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns." The world is also established. It can't be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

7391.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

7392.text: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

7393.text: before the Lord; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

7394.text: The Lord reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

7395.text: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

7396.text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

7397.text: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

7398.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

7399.text: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

7400.text: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

7401.text: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced, because of your judgments, Lord.

7402.text: For you, Lord, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

7403.text: You who love the Lord, hate evil. He preserves the souls of his holy ones. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

7404.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

7405.text: Be glad in the Lord, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

7406.text: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand, and his holy arm, have worked salvation for him.

7407.text: The Lord has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

7408.text: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

7409.text: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

7410.text: Sing praises to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

7411.text: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the Lord.

7412.text: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

7413.text: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

7414.text: Let them sing before the Lord, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

7415.text: The Lord reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

7416.text: The Lord is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

7417.text: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

7418.text: The King's strength also loves justice. You do establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

7419.text: Exalt the Lord our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

7420.text: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel among those who call on his name; they called on the Lord, and he answered them.

7421.text: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

7422.text: You answered them, Lord our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

7423.text: Exalt the Lord, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the Lord, our God, is holy!

7424.text: Shout for joy to the Lord, all you lands!

7425.text: Serve the Lord with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

7426.text: Know that the Lord, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

7427.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

7428.text: For the Lord is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

7429.text: I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, Lord, I will sing praises.

7430.text: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

7431.text: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

7432.text: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

7433.text: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won't tolerate one who is haughty and conceited.

7434.text: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

7435.text: He who practices deceit won't dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won't be established before my eyes.

7436.text: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land; to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the Lord's city.

7437.text: Hear my prayer, Lord! Let my cry come to you.

7438.text: Do not hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

7439.text: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a firebrand.

7440.text: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

7441.text: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

7442.text: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

7443.text: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

7444.text: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

7445.text: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

7446.text: Because of your indignation and your wrath, for you have taken me up, and thrown me away.

7447.text: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

7448.text: But you, Lord, will abide forever; your renown endures to all generations.

7449.text: You will arise and have mercy on Zion; for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

7450.text: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

7451.text: So the nations will fear the name of the Lord; all the kings of the earth your glory.

7452.text: For the Lord has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

7453.text: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

7454.text: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise Yah.

7455.text: For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the Lord saw the earth;

7456.text: to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;

7457.text: that men may declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

7458.text: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

7459.text: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

7460.text: I said, "My God, do not take me away in the midst of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

7461.text: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

7462.text: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

7463.text: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

7464.text: The children of your servants will continue. Their seed will be established before you."

7465.text: Praise the Lord, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

7466.text: Praise the Lord, my soul, and do not forget all his benefits;

7467.text: who forgives all your sins; who heals all your diseases;

7468.text: who redeems your life from destruction; who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies;

7469.text: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

7470.text: The Lord executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

7471.text: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

7472.text: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

7473.text: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

7474.text: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

7475.text: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

7476.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

7477.text: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the Lord has compassion on those who fear him.

7478.text: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

7479.text: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

7480.text: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

7481.text: But the Lord's loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children's children;

7482.text: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

7483.text: The Lord has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

7484.text: Praise the Lord, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

7485.text: Praise the Lord, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

7486.text: Praise the Lord, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the Lord, my soul!

7487.text: Bless the Lord, my soul. The Lord, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

7488.text: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

7489.text: He lays the beams of his chambers in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

7490.text: He makes his angels winds; his servants flames of fire.

7491.text: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

7492.text: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

7493.text: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

7494.text: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

7495.text: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over; that they do not turn again to cover the earth.

7496.text: He sends forth springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

7497.text: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

7498.text: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

7499.text: He waters the mountains from his chambers. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

7500.text: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may bring forth food out of the earth:

7501.text: wine that makes glad the heart of man, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man's heart.

7502.text: The Lord's trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted;

7503.text: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the fir trees.

7504.text: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

7505.text: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

7506.text: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

7507.text: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

7508.text: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

7509.text: Man goes forth to his work, to his labor until the evening.

7510.text: The Lord, how many are your works! In wisdom have you made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

7511.text: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

7512.text: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

7513.text: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

7514.text: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

7515.text: You hide your face: they are troubled; you take away their breath: they die, and return to the dust.

7516.text: You send forth your Spirit: they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

7517.text: Let the glory of the Lord endure forever. Let the Lord rejoice in his works.

7518.text: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

7519.text: I will sing to the Lord as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

7520.text: Let your meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the Lord.

7521.text: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the Lord, my soul. Praise the Lord!

7522.text: Give thanks to the Lord! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

7523.text: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

7524.text: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the Lord rejoice.

7525.text: Seek the Lord and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

7526.text: Remember his marvelous works that he has done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

7527.text: you seed of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

7528.text: He is the Lord, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

7529.text: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

7530.text: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

7531.text: and confirmed the same to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

7532.text: saying, "To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;"

7533.text: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

7534.text: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

7535.text: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

7536.text: "Do not touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!"

7537.text: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

7538.text: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

7539.text: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

7540.text: until the time that his word happened, and the Lord's word proved him true.

7541.text: The king sent and freed him; even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

7542.text: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions;

7543.text: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

7544.text: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

7545.text: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

7546.text: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

7547.text: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

7548.text: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

7549.text: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They did not rebel against his words.

7550.text: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

7551.text: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the chambers of their kings.

7552.text: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

7553.text: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

7554.text: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

7555.text: He spoke, and the locusts came, and the grasshoppers, without number,

7556.text: ate up every plant in their land; and ate up the fruit of their ground.

7557.text: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

7558.text: He brought them forth with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

7559.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

7560.text: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

7561.text: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

7562.text: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

7563.text: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

7564.text: He brought forth his people with joy, his chosen with singing.

7565.text: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

7566.text: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the Lord!

7567.text: Praise Yah! Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

7568.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord, or fully declare all his praise?

7569.text: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

7570.text: Remember me, Lord, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

7571.text: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

7572.text: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

7573.text: Our fathers did not understand your wonders in Egypt. They did not remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

7574.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

7575.text: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

7576.text: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

7577.text: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

7578.text: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

7579.text: They soon forgot his works. They did not wait for his counsel,

7580.text: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

7581.text: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

7582.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the Lord's holy one.

7583.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

7584.text: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

7585.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

7586.text: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

7587.text: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

7588.text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

7589.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn't destroy them.

7590.text: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They did not believe his word,

7591.text: but murmured in their tents, and did not listen to the Lord's voice.

7592.text: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

7593.text: that he would overthrow their seed among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

7594.text: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

7595.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

7596.text: Then Phinehas stood up, and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

7597.text: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

7598.text: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

7599.text: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

7600.text: They did not destroy the peoples, as the Lord commanded them,

7601.text: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

7602.text: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

7603.text: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

7604.text: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

7605.text: Thus were they defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

7606.text: Therefore the Lord burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

7607.text: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

7608.text: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

7609.text: Many times he delivered them, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

7610.text: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

7611.text: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

7612.text: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

7613.text: Save us, Lord, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

7614.text: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, "Amen." Praise the Lord!

7615.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

7616.text: Let the redeemed by the Lord say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

7617.text: And gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

7618.text: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

7619.text: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

7620.text: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses,

7621.text: he led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

7622.text: Let them praise the Lord for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

7623.text: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

7624.text: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

7625.text: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

7626.text: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was none to help.

7627.text: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

7628.text: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke their bonds in sunder.

7629.text: Let them praise the Lord for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

7630.text: For he has broken the gates of brass, and cut through bars of iron.

7631.text: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

7632.text: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

7633.text: Then they cry to the Lord in their trouble, he saves them out of their distresses.

7634.text: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

7635.text: Let them praise the Lord for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works to the children of men!

7636.text: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with singing.

7637.text: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;

7638.text: These see the Lord's works, and his wonders in the deep.

7639.text: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

7640.text: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

7641.text: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits' end.

7642.text: Then they cry to the Lord in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

7643.text: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

7644.text: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

7645.text: Let them praise the Lord for his loving kindness, for his wonderful works for the children of men!

7646.text: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

7647.text: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

7648.text: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

7649.text: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

7650.text: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

7651.text: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

7652.text: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn't allow their livestock to decrease.

7653.text: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

7654.text: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

7655.text: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

7656.text: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

7657.text: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the Lord.

7658.text: My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

7659.text: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

7660.text: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

7661.text: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

7662.text: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

7663.text: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

7664.text: God has spoken from his sanctuary: "In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

7665.text: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

7666.text: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia."

7667.text: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who has led me to Edom?

7668.text: Haven't you rejected us, God? You do not go forth, God, with our armies.

7669.text: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

7670.text: Through God, we will do valiantly. For it is he who will tread down our enemies.

7671.text: God of my praise, do not remain silent,

7672.text: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

7673.text: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

7674.text: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

7675.text: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

7676.text: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

7677.text: When he is judged, let him come forth guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

7678.text: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

7679.text: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

7680.text: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

7681.text: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

7682.text: Let there be none to extend kindness to him, neither let there be any to have pity on his fatherless children.

7683.text: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

7684.text: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the Lord. Do not let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

7685.text: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth;

7686.text: because he did not remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

7687.text: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He did not delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

7688.text: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

7689.text: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

7690.text: This is the reward of my adversaries from the Lord, of those who speak evil against my soul.

7691.text: But deal with me, the Lord the Lord, for your name's sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

7692.text: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

7693.text: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

7694.text: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

7695.text: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

7696.text: Help me, Lord, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

7697.text: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, Lord, have done it.

7698.text: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

7699.text: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

7700.text: I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

7701.text: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

7702.text: The Lord says to my Lord, "Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet."

7703.text: The Lord will send forth the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule in the midst of your enemies.

7704.text: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

7705.text: The Lord has sworn, and will not change his mind: "You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek."

7706.text: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

7707.text: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

7708.text: He will drink of the brook in the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

7709.text: Praise Yah! I will give thanks to the Lord with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

7710.text: The Lord's works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

7711.text: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

7712.text: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The Lord is gracious and merciful.

7713.text: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

7714.text: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

7715.text: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

7716.text: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

7717.text: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

7718.text: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

7719.text: Praise Yah! Blessed is the man who fears the Lord, who delights greatly in his commandments.

7720.text: His seed will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

7721.text: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

7722.text: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

7723.text: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

7724.text: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

7725.text: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the Lord.

7726.text: His heart is established, he will not be afraid until he gaze upon his adversaries.

7727.text: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

7728.text: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

7729.text: Praise Yah! Praise, you servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

7730.text: Blessed be the name of the Lord, from this time forth and forevermore.

7731.text: From the rising of the sun to the going down of the same, The Lord's name is to be praised.

7732.text: The Lord is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

7733.text: Who is like the Lord, our God, who has his seat on high,

7734.text: Who stoops down to see in heaven and in the earth?

7735.text: He raises up the poor out of the dust. Lifts up the needy from the ash heap;

7736.text: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

7737.text: He settles the barren woman in her home, as a joyful mother of children. Praise Yah!

7738.text: When Israel went forth out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language;

7739.text: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

7740.text: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

7741.text: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.

7742.text: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

7743.text: You mountains, that you skipped like rams; you little hills, like lambs?

7744.text: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

7745.text: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

7746.text: Not to us, Lord, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth's sake.

7747.text: Why should the nations say, "Where is their God, now?"

7748.text: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

7749.text: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men's hands.

7750.text: They have mouths, but they do not speak. They have eyes, but they do not see.

7751.text: They have ears, but they do not hear. They have noses, but they do not smell.

7752.text: They have hands, but they do not feel. They have feet, but they do not walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

7753.text: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

7754.text: Israel, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield.

7755.text: House of Aaron, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield.

7756.text: You who fear the Lord, trust in the Lord! He is their help and their shield.

7757.text: The Lord remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

7758.text: He will bless those who fear the Lord, both small and great.

7759.text: May the Lord increase you more and more, you and your children.

7760.text: Blessed are you by the Lord, who made heaven and earth.

7761.text: The heavens are the heavens of the Lord; but the earth has he given to the children of men.

7762.text: The dead do not praise Yah, neither any who go down into silence;

7763.text: But we will bless Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Praise the Lord!

7764.text: I love the Lord, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

7765.text: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

7766.text: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

7767.text: Then I called on the name of the Lord: "Lord, I beg you, deliver my soul."

7768.text: The Lord is Gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

7769.text: The Lord preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

7770.text: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has dealt bountifully with you.

7771.text: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

7772.text: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

7773.text: I believed, therefore I said, "I am greatly afflicted."

7774.text: I said in my haste, "All men are liars."

7775.text: What will I give to the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

7776.text: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the name of the Lord.

7777.text: I will pay my vows to the Lord, yes, in the presence of all his people.

7778.text: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his holy ones.

7779.text: Lord, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your handmaid. You have freed me from my chains.

7780.text: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the name of the Lord.

7781.text: I will pay my vows to the Lord, yes, in the presence of all his people,

7782.text: in the courts of the Lord's house, in the midst of you, Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

7783.text: Praise the Lord, all you nations! Praise him, all you peoples!

7784.text: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The Lord's faithfulness endures forever. Praise Yah!

7785.text: Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

7786.text: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

7787.text: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

7788.text: Now let those who fear the Lord say that his loving kindness endures forever.

7789.text: Out of my distress, I called on Yah. Yah answered me with freedom.

7790.text: The Lord is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

7791.text: The Lord is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

7792.text: It is better to take refuge in the Lord, than to put confidence in man.

7793.text: It is better to take refuge in the Lord, than to put confidence in princes.

7794.text: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the Lord, I cut them off.

7795.text: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the name of the Lord I indeed cut them off.

7796.text: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the name of the Lord I cut them off.

7797.text: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the Lord helped me.

7798.text: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

7799.text: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. "The right hand of the Lord does valiantly.

7800.text: The right hand of the Lord is exalted! The right hand of the Lord does valiantly!"

7801.text: I will not die, but live, and declare the works of Yah.

7802.text: Yah has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

7803.text: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to Yah.

7804.text: This is the gate of the Lord; the righteous will enter into it.

7805.text: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

7806.text: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

7807.text: This is the Lord's doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

7808.text: This is the day that the Lord has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

7809.text: Save us now, we beg you, Lord! Lord, we beg you, send prosperity now.

7810.text: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

7811.text: The Lord is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

7812.text: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

7813.text: Oh give thanks to the Lord, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

7814.text: Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the Lord's Law.

7815.text: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

7816.text: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

7817.text: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

7818.text: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

7819.text: Then I wouldn't be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

7820.text: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

7821.text: I will observe your statutes. Do not utterly forsake me.

7822.text: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

7823.text: With my whole heart, I have sought you. Do not let me wander from your commandments.

7824.text: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

7825.text: Blessed are you, Lord. Teach me your statutes.

7826.text: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

7827.text: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

7828.text: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

7829.text: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.

7830.text: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

7831.text: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your Law.

7832.text: I am a stranger on the earth. Do not hide your commandments from me.

7833.text: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.
